claims.text: ARM-06's Design/tests suite is DIAGONAL, the bar Prime named and ARM-05 cleared. Four mutations, one aimed at each test, full suite run for every one: D1 (boss_stability marked A2-writable) moved ONLY the gate 0->1; D2 (a sim cite pointing at a nonexistent line) moved ONLY the anchors test 0->1; D3 (permanent protected-field violation at tick 4000) moved ONLY the trajectory audit 0->1; D4 (mirror admits adjust_counter with no counter allow-list) moved ONLY the admission control 2->1. Zero off-diagonal movements. Each check is a diagnostic that localises its own defect, not an alarm that fires whenever anything breaks.

The strongest single result: test_e11_authority_gate and test_c10_read_anchors read the SAME file, RX_SKILL_ENUMS_V1.md, and the same §4.1 table — yet a mutation of the WRITE-SCOPE column moves only the gate, and a mutation of the CITE column moves only the anchors test. Shared input did not produce coupled verdicts, which is the failure mode I would have expected and which would have made a §4.1 edit unattributable between the two.

D4 drove the admission control from 2 INCONCLUSIVE to 1 BREACH against a mirror that genuinely admits adjust_counter for any counter. Its exit-1 branch had previously only fired against fake stub modules I wrote in CHECKPOINT-08; this is the first time it has refused a simulated real implementation. The control correctly identified that admitting the exploit is a breach rather than reporting the path merely present.

tests.command: python3 diagonal.py  # 4 aimed mutations x full 4-test suite, scratch tree only

risks: Diagonal on FOUR mutations I chose and aimed. That is evidence of independence, not proof of it. A mutation I did not think of could still move two tests at once, and the mutations were designed by the same person who wrote the tests — the structural weakness ARM-05's sibling replay exists to cover.

The admission control has three branches: ABSENT (2), PRESENT_BUT_UNEXERCISED (2) and BREACH (1). D4 exercised BREACH. PRESENT_BUT_UNEXERCISED was exercised separately in CHECKPOINT-33 against ARM-08's real C++ tree, but not inside this diagonal, so the matrix covers two of its three outcomes.
Every mutation ran against a SCRATCH copy. The real Design/tests and RX_SKILL_ENUMS_V1.md were never written, verified by the fact that the live suite still reports its baseline verdicts.
